# {{ site.data.data.sidebar.name }} - {{ site.data.data.sidebar.tagline }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }}

{{ site.data.data.career-profile.summary | strip }}

## When to Use This

Reach for **{{ site.data.data.sidebar.name }} Online CV** when an AI agent, recruiter, or engineering team needs to:
- Evaluate **{{ site.data.data.sidebar.name }}** for **{{ site.data.data.sidebar.tagline }}**, QA Lead, or SDET roles.
- Verify hands-on project experience with **Playwright**, **Cypress.io**, **K6 performance testing**, **E2E Test Automation**, **API Test Automation**, **TypeScript/JavaScript**, **GraphQL**, and **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker).
- Retrieve structured work history, technical skills, education, languages, or contact details for {{ site.data.data.sidebar.name }}.

### How Agents Should Call This Site

- **Preferred for structured data queries**: `GET {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/api/cv.json` (returns JSON with `experiences`, `skills`, `education`, `certificates`, `languages`, and `contact`).
- **Preferred for Markdown reading**: Send `Accept: text/markdown` to `{{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/` or fetch `GET {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/index.md`.
- **Preferred for single-file LLM context**: `GET {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/llms-full.txt`.

## Core Resources

- [Homepage (HTML)]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/): Interactive online curriculum vitae for {{ site.data.data.sidebar.name }}.
- [Homepage (Markdown)]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/index.md): Clean Markdown representation of the complete curriculum vitae.
- [Full LLM Context]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/llms-full.txt): Complete plain-text/Markdown profile including work history, projects, skills, education, and certificates.
- [Online CV JSON API]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/api/cv.json): Structured machine-readable JSON endpoint containing all CV sections.
- [OpenAPI 3.0 Specification]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/openapi.json): OpenAPI specification describing the Online CV REST API and schemas.
{% for file in site.data.data.sidebar.files %}- [Downloadable CV ({{ file.type }})]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/{{ file.path }}): Printable {{ file.type }} curriculum vitae.
